# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest version of My Connection on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.zanin.myconnection) receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for security problems.

Report it privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MattZ6/my-connection/security/advisories/new). Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the app version and device you used.

You'll get a reply within 7 days. Once the issue is confirmed, a fix ships in the next release and you'll be credited in the advisory, unless you prefer otherwise.
